subject: Proposed Tree Ordinance
overview: The Medford City Council Committee of the Whole met to discuss draft updates to Paper 19070, the proposed tree ordinance. The committee reviewed proposed private property regulations and voted on several amendments to the draft Tree Committee structure before referring the proposals for departmental and advisory review.

items.title: Private Property Tree Protection Regulations
items.summary: Acting Building Commissioner Bill Forte presented a redlined draft establishing tree mitigation schedules, replacement rules, and lot-clearing standards for private property under building department purview.

items.title: Tree Committee Structure and Amendments
items.summary: The committee approved motions to strike the prohibition on member compensation, grant flexibility for certified arborist qualification and residency requirements, and require City Council confirmation for mayoral appointees.

items.title: Ordinance Referrals for Departmental and Public Review
items.summary: The committee voted to send prior public tree ordinance motions to the Tree Warden and KP Law, and referred the draft Tree Committee and private tree ordinances to the Planning, Development, and Sustainability Department, the Energy and Environment Committee, and Trees Medford for comment.
